Top-k of 20 packs a large slice of the corpus into the prompt. Cut k and keep recall by reranking.
Rerank lifts chunks whose document title matches the query. It matters most when k is small.
Every retrieved chunk is sent in full, so prompt tokens grow with chunk size times k. Smaller chunks let you keep more of them.
A working point on this corpus is topK 2, rerank true, chunkSize 200.
